sprint.title: Persistent Actor Location Baseline
sprint.goal: Persist sparse runtime location overrides for seeded named static actors and provide one atomic actor-location mutation operation.

architectural_decision.title: Authored Actors Retain Immutable Identity and Description While World State Owns Mutable Runtime Location

acceptance_criteria: Supported named static actors have unique non-empty entity_id values and valid authored locations.
World State stores only sparse valid actor location overrides and legacy missing data normalizes to an empty mapping.
Scene Snapshot projects each static actor once at its effective runtime-or-authored location while spawned entities remain unchanged.
GameEngine exposes one atomic set_actor_location operation with true no-op and baseline-removal behavior.
Material moves create exactly one actor_moved history entry and failures preserve live state and exact scene identity.
Save version remains 1 and preserves material overrides with defensive deterministic behavior.
non_goals: actor knowledge, relationships, health, inventory, or disposition
governance: Region Packs retain immutable authored actor data.
World State owns sparse runtime location differences.
Do not substitute bundled, system, Windows Store, or alternate Python.

closeout.verification_result: Focused actor-location and save/load tests passed; all 19 repository tests passed through the official interpreter; final workflow checks completed.
closeout.non_goals_preserved: No spawned-instance persistence, schedules, autonomous movement, commands, pathfinding, generic components, or broader actor state.
